# Hyro Vision (https://hyrovision.com)
> High-performance digital products, AI-powered systems, and intelligent automation solutions.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: Hyro Vision
- **Website**: https://hyrovision.com
- **Description**: Hyro Vision is a modern technology and IT services engineering company. We build intelligent digital products, full-stack web applications, SaaS platforms, enterprise systems, and AI-powered automation solutions.
- **Headquarters**: Remote Worldwide · Engineering Hub
- **Contact Email**: info@hyrovision.com

## Core Engineering Services
- **Full-Stack Web Application Development**: End-to-end web engineering, React/Next.js frontends, scalable Node.js/Python backends, and performant API architectures. (https://hyrovision.com/services/fullstack-web)
- **Custom SaaS & Enterprise Dashboards**: Multi-tenant architectures, role-based access control (RBAC), and custom enterprise management software. (https://hyrovision.com/services/saas-enterprise)
- **AI Integration & Autonomous Workflows**: Production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector embeddings, multi-provider LLM routers, and autonomous workflow automation. (https://hyrovision.com/services/ai-integration)
- **Backend Architecture & Database Design**: Resilient database modeling (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase), connection pooling, caching layers, and high-throughput APIs. (https://hyrovision.com/services/backend-database)
- **Cloud Deployment & Technical SEO**: High-availability CDN deployment on Vercel/AWS, automated CI/CD pipelines, Core Web Vitals optimization, and structured data architecture. (https://hyrovision.com/services/cloud-seo)

## Public Projects & Case Studies
- **HillsTourism** (Status: LIVE)
  - **Category**: Tourism / Travel Technology
  - **URL**: https://hillstourism.com
  - **Case Study**: https://hyrovision.com/projects/hills-tourism

- **Super D — Hospital Management System** (Status: ONGOING)
  - **Category**: Healthcare / Hospital Management
  - **Status Notice**: Project currently under development.
  - **Case Study**: https://hyrovision.com/projects/super-d-hospital-management
  - **Overview**: Comprehensive hospital information and management system engineered for electronic medical records (EMR), doctor scheduling, department workflows, and clinical operations.
